item.title: Rivers of Ink: A light and sound journey through the world’s oldest Bible and its North East roots
item.description: A striking new light and sound installation is touring the North East this February, telling the remarkable story of Codex Amiatinus, the oldest intact complete Bible in existence. The Rivers of Ink installation has been created by London-based artists Karen Monid and Ross Ashton of The Projection Studio in collaboration with Durham University researchers.
